statements.name: Agent100.GroupII.domain_core_bounds
statements.signature_source:
theorem domain_core_bounds (r p u v : Nat) (h : Domain r p u v) :
    1 ≤ 4 * u - 19 ∧ 4 * u - 19 ≤ 13 ∧
      2 ≤ 4 * v - 18 ∧ 4 * v - 18 ≤ 6 ∧
      1 ≤ 2 * (u + v) - 19 ∧ 2 * (u + v) - 19 ≤ 7

statements.name: Agent100.GroupII.domain_seven_cores
statements.signature_source:
theorem domain_seven_cores (r p u v : Nat) (h : Domain r p u v) :
    (u = 5 ∧ v = 5) ∨ (u = 5 ∧ v = 6) ∨
      (u = 6 ∧ v = 5) ∨ (u = 6 ∧ v = 6) ∨
      (u = 7 ∧ v = 5) ∨ (u = 7 ∧ v = 6) ∨ (u = 8 ∧ v = 5)

theorem component_carry (r p u v : Nat) (h : Domain r p u v) :

statements.name: Agent100.GroupII.returnedComponent_symmetric
statements.signature_source:
theorem returnedComponent_symmetric (r p u v : Nat) (hr : 1 ≤ r) :
    ∀ i, i < 2 * r + 6 →
      returnedComponent r p u v i = returnedComponent r p u v (2 * r + 6 - 1 - i)

statements.name: Agent100.GroupII.returnedComponent_core_table
statements.signature_source:
theorem returnedComponent_core_table (r p u v : Nat) (hr : 1 ≤ r) :
    returnedComponent r p u v r = 1 ∧
      returnedComponent r p u v (r + 1) = 4 * u - 19 ∧
      returnedComponent r p u v (r + 2) = 4 * v - 18 ∧
      returnedComponent r p u v (r + 3) = 4 * v - 18 ∧
      returnedComponent r p u v (r + 4) = 4 * u - 19 ∧
      returnedComponent r p u v (r + 5) = 1
